paragraphs.text: Rubina Larkingdale is a first-year student of Silverquill College at Strixhaven University, hailing from the plane of Arcavios . Known for her commanding presence and formidable stagecraft, Rubina quickly earned a reputation as one of the most serious and talented student performers on campus.

A prominent member of the Playactors Drama Guild, Rubina brings weight and dignity to roles that many of her peers find too challenging. Her gravitas, paired with a restrained yet powerful delivery, often puts her at odds with more flamboyant actors who compete for the same coveted parts. Within the guild, tensions sometimes flare, but Rubina's professionalism and reputation for excellence keep her at the center of most major productions.

Beyond the theater, Rubina channels her discipline into music. As a member of the Strixhaven Show Band Association, she initially performed with an instrument, but quickly advanced to the role of conductor. Despite her first-year status, Rubina commands the respect of the entire ensemble. Her authority is so complete that a single glance or lifted brow can silence a noisy section or halt an argument without a word.

Rubina's powerful oratory skills also enhance her academic performance. In lectures and class presentations, her delivery is so potent that listeners often describe her speeches as rousing and cinematic, akin to a battle-worn general rallying troops before a final stand.
Though she holds no on-campus job, Rubina's extracurriculars and leadership roles keep her deeply involved in the cultural life of Strixhaven.

Rubina's quiet intensity has a lasting impact on those close to her. Friends find themselves unintentionally adopting her commanding presence, able to capture the attention of a room with ease. In conversations or debates, their words carry unexpected authority, making it easier to sway opinions and gain support, even from skeptical peers.

For Rubina's rivals, however, her perfectionism casts a long shadow. Student musicians, especially those performing in public, often falter when they notice her and/or her associates in the crowd. Haunted by the fear of not measuring up to Rubina's exacting standards, they second-guess their skills and frequently deliver subpar performances, blaming the presence of her known acquaintances as an unsettling reminder of her critical gaze.
